en.authority: Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs / e-Sbírka
en.text: Article 10 — Dividends. Dividends paid by a company resident in a Contracting State to a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State. They may also be taxed in the State of the payer, but where the beneficial owner is a resident of the other Contracting State the tax shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends. The permanent-establishment effective-connection exception applies.

en.authority: Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs / e-Sbírka
en.text: Article 11 — Interest. Interest arising in a Contracting State may be taxed in the other Contracting State and may also be taxed in the source State, but where the beneficial owner is a resident of the other Contracting State the source-State tax shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount. Notwithstanding that rule, qualifying interest beneficially owned by the other State, its subdivisions or local authorities, its central bank, qualifying government-owned or controlled financial institutions, qualifying guaranteed or insured financing, and qualifying credit sales is exempt in the source State. The permanent-establishment effective-connection exception applies.

en.authority: Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs / e-Sbírka
en.text: Article 12 — Royalties. Royalties arising in a Contracting State may be taxed in the other Contracting State and may also be taxed in the source State. Where the beneficial owner is a resident of the other Contracting State, the source-State ceiling is 10 per cent for patents, trademarks, designs or models, plans, secret formulae or processes, industrial, commercial or scientific equipment and know-how, and 0 per cent for copyright of literary, artistic or scientific works including cinematograph films and films or tapes for television or radio broadcasting. The permanent-establishment effective-connection exception applies.
